title: Kinematics of Motion in a Straight Line Module 4 Lesson 2: Constructing and Solving Graphs custom practice

evidence_basis.originality_note: All prompts, numerical values and physical configurations are original; mapped Cambridge past-paper evidence informs cognitive demand and assessment structure only.

parts.prompt: A car accelerates from rest to $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$ in $10\text{ s}$, cruises at $20\text{ m s}^{-1}$ for $T\text{ s}$, and decelerates uniformly to rest in $15\text{ s}$. Given that the total distance travelled is $950\text{ m}$, find the value of $T$.

A motorcycle accelerates uniformly from rest for $12\text{ s}$ to speed $V\text{ m s}^{-1}$, and then immediately decelerates uniformly to rest in $8\text{ s}$. Given that the total distance travelled is $240\text{ m}$, find the value of $V$.

A particle moves in a straight line from a fixed point $O$. It accelerates from rest to $8\text{ m s}^{-1}$ in $4\text{ s}$ and immediately decelerates to rest in $2\text{ s}$. It then moves backwards, accelerating uniformly to speed $V\text{ m s}^{-1}$ in $3\text{ s}$ and decelerating to rest in $1\text{ s}$. Given that the particle returns to $O$, find the value of $V$.
A vehicle travelling at $U\text{ m s}^{-1}$ accelerates uniformly at $2\text{ m s}^{-2}$ for $5\text{ s}$, covering a distance of $85\text{ m}$. Find the initial speed $U$.

A train travelling at $16\text{ m s}^{-1}$ decelerates uniformly at $a\text{ m s}^{-2}$ for $6\text{ s}$ to speed $v_1$, and then immediately decelerates at $3a\text{ m s}^{-2}$ for $2\text{ s}$ until coming to rest. Find the value of $a$.
A car cruises at a constant speed of $15\text{ m s}^{-1}$ for $20\text{ s}$, then brakes uniformly at $2.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$ until coming to rest. Find the total distance travelled by the car.

questions.prompt: A delivery van travels along a straight road between two depots, $A$ and $B$, which are $720\text{ m}$ apart. The van starts from rest at $A$ and accelerates uniformly for $10\text{ s}$ until reaching speed $V\text{ m s}^{-1}$. It travels at this constant speed for $25\text{ s}$, and then decelerates uniformly to rest at $B$ over a period of $15\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the value of $V$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration during the first $10\text{ s}$ and the deceleration during the final $15\text{ s}$.

questions.prompt: A tram travels along a straight track of length $600\text{ m}$ from rest at stop $P$ to rest at stop $Q$. The tram accelerates uniformly at $2\text{ m s}^{-2}$ for $10\text{ s}$, travels at constant speed for $T_1\text{ s}$, and decelerates uniformly to rest at $2.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the maximum speed reached by the tram, the distance travelled while accelerating, and the distance travelled while decelerating.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the cruising duration $T_1$ and the total time taken for the trip from $P$ to $Q$.

questions.prompt: The motion of a tractor along a straight lane is modeled by a velocity-time graph consisting of four straight line segments. The tractor passes point $O$ at $t = 0$ with speed $U\text{ m s}^{-1}$. It accelerates uniformly to speed $V\text{ m s}^{-1}$ over $6\text{ s}$, and then travels at this constant speed $V$ for a further $24\text{ s}$. The tractor then accelerates uniformly to a speed of $14\text{ m s}^{-1}$ over a period of $6\text{ s}$. Finally, it decelerates uniformly to rest over a period of $12\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Given that the acceleration of the tractor between $t = 30$ and $t = 36$ is $0.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$, find the value of $V$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Given that the total distance covered by the tractor during the $48\text{ s}$ of motion is $480\text{ m}$, find the initial speed $U$, and find the average speed of the tractor for the entire journey.

questions.prompt: A bus travels along a straight road between two stops. The bus starts from rest at $t = 0$ and accelerates uniformly for $10\text{ s}$ until reaching a speed of $15\text{ m s}^{-1}$. It maintains this speed for $35\text{ s}$. From $t = 45$ to $t = 55$, it decelerates uniformly at $a\text{ m s}^{-2}$ to an intermediate speed $v_1$. From $t = 55$ to $t = 60$, it decelerates uniformly at $2a\text{ m s}^{-2}$ until coming to rest at the second stop.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the value of $a$ and the speed $v_1$ of the bus at $t = 55\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Calculate the total distance covered by the bus over the entire $60\text{ s}$ journey, and find its average speed.

questions.prompt: The velocity $v\text{ m s}^{-1}$ of a particle at time $t$ seconds after leaving a fixed point $O$ is modeled by a velocity-time graph consisting of straight line segments. The particle accelerates from rest to $1.2\text{ m s}^{-1}$ in $4\text{ s}$, travels at $1.2\text{ m s}^{-1}$ for $8\text{ s}$, and comes instantaneously to rest $2\text{ s}$ later. The particle then moves backwards, accelerating uniformly to minimum velocity $-V\text{ m s}^{-1}$ in $3\text{ s}$, and then decelerates uniformly to rest at point $O$ at time $T\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the distance travelled by the particle in the first $14\text{ s}$ of its motion.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Given that $T = 20$, find the minimum velocity of the particle.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: Given instead that the greatest speed of the particle during the return journey is $2.2\text{ m s}^{-1}$, find $T$ and calculate the average speed of the particle for the whole motion.

questions.prompt: The velocity-time graph of a particle moving along a straight line consists of five straight line segments. The particle starts from rest at point $A$ at $t = 0$. It accelerates uniformly to $12\text{ m s}^{-1}$ over $4\text{ s}$, maintains this speed for $6\text{ s}$ (until $t = 10$), and then decelerates uniformly at $4\text{ m s}^{-2}$ until reaching velocity $-8\text{ m s}^{-1}$ at time $t_2$. It travels at constant velocity $-8\text{ m s}^{-1}$ for $5\text{ s}$, and then decelerates uniformly to rest at point $B$ at time $T$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the time at which the particle instantaneously comes to rest, the time $t_2$, and the total forward distance travelled by the particle from point $A$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Given that the total distance travelled by the particle between $t = 0$ and $t = T$ is $180\text{ m}$, find the value of $T$ and calculate the distance between points $A$ and $B$.

questions.prompt: A high-speed electric locomotive travels a fixed distance $D = 2400\text{ m}$ from rest at station $P$ to rest at station $Q$. The maximum acceleration of the locomotive is $a = 1.0\text{ m s}^{-2}$ and its maximum deceleration is $d = 2.0\text{ m s}^{-2}$. The locomotive cruises at constant speed $V\text{ m s}^{-1}$ between the acceleration and deceleration phases.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Show that the total journey time $T$ as a function of the cruising speed $V$ is given by $T = 0.75V + \frac{2400}{V}$, and find the maximum possible cruising speed $V_{\max}$ for which a constant-speed cruising phase exists.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Given that the cruising speed is set to $V = 40\text{ m s}^{-1}$, find the duration of each of the three stages, the total journey time $T$, and the average speed of the locomotive.
